card.fires_on: The space or small word (a, as, of) right before a number plus unit in a size or amount, such as '5-gallon', '28 inches', or 'a quart'. It is mostly in general web text about gardening, animals, fishing and recipes.

modes.description: The blank space just before a measurement figure in a size description.
